# pvecli backup jobs

Scheduled backup jobs: list, add, edit, remove, enable, disable, run.

## list

Scheduled backup jobs.

```text
pvecli backup jobs list [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile(s): name, list, pattern ('client-*') or @group. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## add

Create a scheduled backup job.

Without --keep-* the retention of the storage applies.

```text
pvecli backup jobs add [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--schedule VALUE` |  | When: '02:00', 'sat 03:30', 'mon..fri 22:00'. |
| `-s`, `--storage VALUE` |  | Backup storage. |
| `-id`, `--vmid VALUE` |  | Guests: 100,101. |
| `-a`, `--all` |  | Every guest. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` |  | Guests of this pool. |
| `-ex`, `--exclude VALUE` |  | With --all: guests to leave out. |
| `-m`, `--mode VALUE` | `snapshot` | snapshot, suspend or stop. |
| `-cp`, `--compress VALUE` | `zstd` | zstd, gzip, lzo or 0 (none; ignored by PBS). |
| `--notes-template VALUE` |  | Notes of each backup ({{guestname}}...). |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` |  | Description of the job. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` |  | Only run on this node. |
| `--keep-last N` |  | Retention: keep the N newest backups. |
| `--keep-daily N` |  | Retention: one per day, N days. |
| `--keep-weekly N` |  | Retention: one per week, N weeks. |
| `--keep-monthly N` |  | Retention: one per month, N months. |
| `--keep-yearly N` |  | Retention: one per year, N years. |
| `--disabled` |  | Create the job disabled. |
| `--id VALUE` |  | Job ID (default: generated by PVE). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |

### Examples

```bash
pvecli backup jobs add --schedule 02:00 --all --exclude 9000 --storage pbs --keep-daily 7
pvecli backup jobs add --schedule 'sat 03:00' --pool prod --storage nfs --mode stop
```

## edit

Change a backup job: only the options given are sent.

```text
pvecli backup jobs edit JOB_ID [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `JOB_ID` | Job ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--schedule VALUE` | When: '02:00', 'sat 03:30'. |
| `-s`, `--storage VALUE` | Backup storage. |
| `-id`, `--vmid VALUE` | Guests: 100,101 (replaces the selection). |
| `-a`, `--all` | Every guest (replaces the selection). |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Guests of this pool (replaces the selection). |
| `-ex`, `--exclude VALUE` | With --all: guests to leave out. |
| `-m`, `--mode VALUE` | snapshot, suspend or stop. |
| `-cp`, `--compress VALUE` | zstd, gzip, lzo or 0. |
| `--notes-template VALUE` | Notes of each backup. |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` | Description of the job. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Only run on this node. |
| `--keep-last N` | Retention: keep the N newest backups. |
| `--keep-daily N` | Retention: one per day, N days. |
| `--keep-weekly N` | Retention: one per week, N weeks. |
| `--keep-monthly N` | Retention: one per month, N months. |
| `--keep-yearly N` | Retention: one per year, N years. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## remove

Delete a backup job (its backups are kept).

```text
pvecli backup jobs remove JOB_ID [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `JOB_ID` | Job ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## disable

Disable a backup job (kept, not scheduled).

```text
pvecli backup jobs disable JOB_ID [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `JOB_ID` | Job ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## run

Run a backup job now, with its own options, then check each guest.

There is no 'run job' endpoint: this sends the job's options to vzdump
on each node, with job-id when allowed (root@pam only).

```text
pvecli backup jobs run JOB_ID [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `JOB_ID` | Job ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
